P03.current_evidence: Guided tools retain selected context; explicit GFS/best-match comparison and both national historical measures now survive the rules path. Multi-turn and unfamiliar compound-request generalisation remain open.

P04.current_evidence: Official sea-area and coastal text is reachable as published documents with page, issue and currency attached, while the marine tool returns modeled wave cells at the answering grid. Named sea-area identity, printed validity windows and a domain-reviewed specialist composition remain open; the recorded decision is not to invent a mapping.

P06.current_evidence: A local plan watcher, activity templates, inbox, browser notification code and lifecycle tests exist (docs/67). Live changed-edition delivery, origin authentication, flood/cyclone applicability and offline delivery remain unaccepted.

P07.current_evidence: District and national corpus queries, cross-language retrieval and bounded whole-edition section coverage are connected. The new live national reading served 11 indexed sections. Held layouts, contradiction handling and field applicability remain open.

P08.current_evidence: Historical district misses now offer source-lined place-index candidates (alternate spellings such as Mysore, and the district a settlement falls in such as Khurda) that require confirmation; two live journeys answered after selection and an unknown name kept the refusal. No reviewed dated crosswalk exists, so no automatic alias resolution is claimed.

P09.current_evidence: Stored forecast vintages were compared for 4,032 overlapping valid hours: mean absolute change 0.70 C for temperature, 3.98 percent for humidity, 0.94 mm for precipitation, with the largest change coming from two retrievals one second apart. This is vintage variance, not skill: upstream run identity is not exposed and no matched observations exist, so no accuracy, calibration or confidence number is produced.

P10.current_evidence: Request-driven collection, a bounded foreground cycle, scheduled briefing loop and local background plan watcher exist. Shared-store contention, cold latency, sustained refresh and multi-user throughput remain unaccepted.

P11.current_evidence: Bounded queue, stage progress and cooperative cancellation are implemented. Source read/lock latency and an in-flight provider call can still outlast page waits; no load acceptance.

P12.current_evidence: Benchmark scorer v2 allocates each declared measure once, checks execution parameters and preserves failed-turn denominators. Both initial failures and the release run are retained. It is still status-based development evidence, not independent correctness or representative generalisation.

P13.current_evidence: The desktop workspace exposes 15 guided tools. The language ledger has 19 verified write gates and 10 speak/hear gates; voice controls and audio probes exist. Native-speaker, noisy-input, screen-reader and real mobile acceptance remain open.

P14.current_evidence: Local verification and a detached clean checkout pass 1,017 Python tests, eight JS suites and static checks on the same macOS environment. A runtime-fixture dependency was repaired using existing tracked hash-verified source files; the initial failure is preserved. Fresh-machine/cross-platform installation, CI service, sustained load and deployment remain unaccepted; hosting is held.

P15.current_evidence: Current review pointers and stage summaries now target docs/72; the previous product registry is archived. Historical snapshots are labelled as such, and the status drift guard remains in verification.
